result.reason: The new indemnity substantively covers the requested vendor risks and includes basic claim procedures, but it appears subject to Section 7’s existing liability cap; it neither carves the indemnity out of that cap nor applies the fallback 3× annual-fees super-cap. The added bilateral attorneys’ fees waiver is unrelated to the requested indemnity, changes separate litigation economics, and may create ambiguity with recovery of indemnified attorneys’ fees. The drafting also duplicates the section heading and subsection (c), resulting in defective numbering. The operative changes therefore do not fully reach the playbook position and are broader than necessary.
